title: Use a single character sheet with front/side/back views as the reference in…
content:
Use a single character sheet with front/side/back views as the reference in Seedance 2.0 to keep the character consistent across every shot in 4K.

Use Seedance 2.0 video-to-video to upscale your own footage to native 4K at full resolution.

Reuse the same model and the same reference images across shots to maintain consistent details (e.g., helmet texture) with sharper output.
